findings.claim: The OS is a bare-metal RISC-V FPGA runtime for Pocket/MiSTer, not a hardware implementation of the Archimedes computer.

OS applications are compiled rv32imafc/ilp32f and therefore cannot directly execute the Archimedes ARM binaries on the supplied Lotus discs. They would need an Archimedes emulator or a reconstructed native game implementation.
SDK app boot ABI uses a SysV initial stack and vendor auxv tags for capability/service table pointers. Apps are not standalone FPGA hardware cores.

SDK source boots with an indexed 320x240 framebuffer but exposes larger source modes, max width 800/max height 600, physical output 320x240, and a 50 Hz vertical-total constant. It should not be described as strictly fixed to 320x240/60 Hz. This limited header inspection does not establish faithful native 320x256 Archimedes display support.
Current project direction is the standalone openFPGA Archimedes ARM/VIDC hardware route. SDK/runtime merits do not determine that route; these repositories are optional interface examples.
